name: context-viewer
description: View-only Token Gauge and Context Inventory for Antigravity Conversations.

contextViewer.roots.markdownDescription: Data roots to scan (each has `brain/`, `conversations/`, `annotations/`, `conversation_summaries.db`). `~` is expanded.

contextViewer.maxConversations.description: Caps the Conversations shown in the tree, counting the Active Conversation. The status bar shows the Active Conversation only.

contextViewer.recentExpiryMinutes.description: A Recent Conversation is dropped this many minutes after it entered the Recent list.

contextViewer.threshold.markdownDescription:
**Unit: thousands of tokens (k).** Enter `150` for 150,000, not `150000`.

Sets the traffic-light colour from the context **actually used**: 🟢 up to 50% of the Threshold, 🟡 above 50%, 🟠 above 80%, 🔴 above 100%. Independent of the model's Context window, so you can be warned well before the model's maximum. Applies to every model not listed in `#contextViewer.thresholdPerModel#`. Clear it to use each model's Context window as its Threshold.

contextViewer.thresholdPerModel.markdownDescription: **Unit: thousands of tokens (k).** Threshold for specific models, keyed by model name without the effort level, e.g. `{ "Gemini 3.8 Flash": 190 }`. Sets the traffic-light colour like `#contextViewer.threshold#`, which applies to models not listed here.

contextViewer.contextWindow.markdownDescription:
**Unit: thousands of tokens (k).** Enter `256` for 256,000, not `256000`.

The model's **maximum** context: the denominator of the status bar figures (`62% · 159k/256k`) and of the heavy-item %. Does not change the colours (see `#contextViewer.threshold#`). Last resort: used only when neither `#contextViewer.contextWindowPerModel#`, Antigravity, nor a built-in value knows the model's window. Empty: no limit known.

contextViewer.contextWindowPerModel.markdownDescription: **Unit: thousands of tokens (k).** The model's maximum context for specific models, keyed by model name without the effort level, e.g. `{ "Gemini 3.8 Flash": 256 }`. Takes precedence over what Antigravity reports. Does not change the colours.

contextViewer.heavyItemPercent.description: Chat Messages items above this % of the Context window are highlighted.

contextViewer.hoverChars.description: Hover cut-off for chat item text: head 75%, tail 25%; thinking budget 50%.

contextViewer.logLevel.markdownDescription: How much is written to the **Context Viewer** Output panel (View → Output). Display is unaffected. `off`: nothing. `error`: failures only. `info`: also data-source switches (`rpc` ↔ `file`, server found or lost). `debug`: also every poll hit and RPC call timing. Lines are redacted (tokens, emails, account fields).
enumDescriptions: Everything, incl. each poll and RPC call
